page.layout: One column of handwritten index lines, names at left with page numbers at right. Section letters G, H and 1 stand as headings. No running head, page number or catchword. Top line is a handwritten annotation above the list.
page.notes: The whole page is manuscript handwriting, not print. It is transcribed here because it is the page's only content, but the script should check whether it belongs in the book's table of contents. Handwritten top line, not transcribed: "Dr Sacra Coena Dm 107 6 .69a 285.6." Doubtful readings: Sūpphen, the page number 164 or 166 after Hubertus Chariet and Gabriel Beraudin, and the numbers 150 and 68 at the foot. Several names are abbreviated, such as Ioes for Ioannes, and are kept as written. Names and numbers are read from the scan and may contain errors.
